landing.badge: Official portal of Santa Cicilia Subdivision
landing.heroSub: Check your meter reading, monthly consumption, and balance anytime. Pay online and send your concerns directly to the office — no more waiting in line.
landing.trust1: Photo evidence for every meter reading
landing.featuresSub: Built for homeowners, staff, and the HOA office.
landing.f1Body: See the previous and present reading, your consumption, the rate used, and the total — including the photo of your own meter.
landing.f2Body: A 12-month chart for water (m³) and electricity (kWh) so you can see if your usage went up or down.
landing.f3Body: Transfer via GCash, Maya, or bank, then upload your proof. Track the status until it is confirmed by the admin.
landing.f4Body: Send billing concerns, meter issues, or required documents straight to the staff and admin. Everything is recorded.
landing.f5Body: Water interruptions, deadlines, and HOA notices — all in one feed instead of scattered in group chats.
landing.f6Body: Download your SOA as PDF anytime — useful for clearance, loans, and record-keeping.
landing.howSub: From meter reading to confirmed payment.
landing.s1Body: Staff reads your water and electric meter and uploads a photo as evidence. No photo, no reading.
landing.s2Body: The system computes your consumption using the approved rate. You get notified once the bill is released.
landing.s3Body: Transfer via GCash, Maya, or bank and upload your proof of payment in the portal.
landing.s4Body: Staff checks your proof and endorses it. The admin gives the final confirmation and your receipt is issued.
landing.q1: How do I get an account?
landing.a1: Click Register and fill in your name, contact number, and your Block and Lot. The admin will verify that you are a resident before your account is activated.
landing.a2: It is the unit of water consumption — the difference between last month's reading and this month's reading on your water meter. Electricity uses kWh (kilowatt-hour).
landing.a3: Transfer the amount through GCash, Maya, or bank transfer, then upload the screenshot or receipt in the portal along with the reference number.
landing.q4: Why is my payment still not confirmed?
landing.a4: Every payment passes two checks: the staff verifies your proof first, then the admin gives the final confirmation. You will see the status in your payment history.
landing.q5: I think my bill is wrong. What do I do?
landing.a5: Open the bill, check the meter photo attached to it, then send a message under the Billing Concern category. The staff will respond within 24 hours.
landing.q6: Can the staff see or change my account?
landing.a6: No. Staff can only see your billing information and your concerns. Only the admin can manage accounts.
landing.contactSub: Visit the HOA office or message us.
landing.ctaBannerSub: Create your account in less than two minutes.
landing.footerNote: Official billing portal of Santa Cicilia Subdivision.
